chain.name: sRGB
chain.description:
RGB is a standard RGB color space created cooperatively by HP and Microsoft in 1996 for use on monitors, printers and the Internet

Note that sRGB's small Gamut is not suitable for graphic production.

Encompasses roughly 35% of the visible colors specified by the Lab color space

meta.description: sRGB identity — open in Photoshop, apply colour grade, reimport as LUT
